turns.text: I'm more of an indoor person to be honest.
I love reading and I'm taking a cooking class on weekends.
turns.zh: 我喜欢看书，周末还在上烹饪课。

turns.text: Always wanted to learn how to make decent pasta from scratch.
turns.zh: 一直想学怎么做像样的手工意面。

turns.text: I basically live on takeout and frozen meals.
turns.zh: 我基本上就靠外卖和速冻食品过日子。

turns.text: Well, once I master this pasta thing, maybe I can teach you a few basic recipes.
turns.zh: 等我掌握了这个意面，说不定能教你几个基础菜谱。
